observations: Large office copier wrapped in clear plastic sheeting in all three photos.
"SHARP AR-M207" model marking visible on the front lower panel in photo 0, photo 1, and photo 2.
Automatic document feeder on top visible in photo 0 and photo 2.
Paper size indicators "A4" and "A3" visible on trays in photo 1.
"digital" logo on the right side in photo 1.
Watermark "POSTED ON JIJI SMATECH MEGA EQUIPMENT" across photos.
No power cord, toner, output quality, or error codes visible because the unit is sealed in plastic.

claims.evidence: No origin markings, import documents, or plug type visible in photos.

claims.claim: AR-M207 is packed with extensive range of superb performance functions
claims.evidence: Model matches the photo, but functions cannot be tested through plastic wrapping.
Machine is sealed in plastic; no power-on, copy, or scan test shown.

risks.risk: Machine does not power on or is electrically faulty
risks.proof: Video of the copier powering on with ready light and no error codes

risks.risk: Copier or scanner functions fail or produce poor quality
risks.proof: Video of making a copy from the glass and scanning a document

risks.risk: Document feeder jams or does not feed pages
risks.proof: Video of the document feeder scanning multiple pages

risks.risk: Paper trays (A3/A4) do not feed paper
risks.proof: Video of paper feeding from each tray

risks.risk: Toner or drum near end of life or missing
risks.proof: Photo of the toner cartridge and total page counter

proof_requests: Video of the copier powering on with no error codes
Video of it making a copy from the glass and from the document feeder
Photo of the toner level and total page count
Video of paper feeding from the A3 and A4 trays
response.reason: The Sharp AR-M207 digital photocopier is clearly identifiable from the model marking in all photos, so it can be priced at its worst case as an untested, wrapped unit.
